qt: to the Commission Martin Sonneborn (NI) Subject:

In its answer to Written Question E-002921/20261, the Commission mentions that the reduction of Indian tariffs on beer from 110 % to 50 % would help strengthen the competitiveness of the EU brewing industry. The negotiations were concluded in January 2026 and the proposals for signature were submitted to the Council in September 2026. The Agreement has yet to be signed or ratified and the consent of the European Parliament is still pending. 1.
Does the Commission consider the remaining 50 % tariff to constitute an effective market incentive?
What additional annual export volume does it expect for tasty beer?
What proportion of EU beer exports to India is currently accounted for by breweries with an annual output of less than 200 000 hectolitres?
